candidates.title: Dark navy gold bar consultation poster
candidates.description: A premium dark navy poster layout with a real gold bar on a stone surface, controlled metallic reflection, wide blank headline area on the left, calm private banking mood, no readable text.

candidates.title: Gold coin investment banner
candidates.description: Gold coin stack photographed with soft studio lighting, white and navy negative space, conservative wealth management tone, product clearly reads as bullion investment, space for Korean headline and CTA.

candidates.title: Luxury gold abstract background
candidates.description: Elegant dark gold abstract wave background with premium feeling and enough blank space, but no visible gold bar, coin, consultation cue, or financial product identity.

candidates.title: Gold bars close-up crop
candidates.description: Very strong bullion product close-up with realistic metal texture, but the crop is tight, headline space is almost absent, and it would be difficult to use as cardnews main visual.

candidates.title: Cute gold mascot camping scene
candidates.description: Cute 3D mascot holding a gold coin near a small camping tent, picnic props, toy-like material, playful bright colors, fake poster text in the background.

candidates.title: Casino gold jackpot typography
candidates.description: Flashy gold typography, casino-like lights, jackpot mood, fake numbers and unreadable text, more like a game promotion than a financial consultation event.

candidates.title: Clinical warm serum product layout
candidates.description: Clean serum bottle product photography on a white surface, soft warm clinical light, subtle texture swatch, clear blank area for headline, credible skincare efficacy mood without exaggerated claims.

candidates.title: Texture and ingredient card layout
candidates.description: Minimal skincare texture close-up with ingredient cue, structured layout zone for benefit copy, bright clean lighting, premium but approachable dermocosmetic tone.

candidates.title: Soft spa mood with flowers
candidates.description: Soft pastel bathroom spa mood with flowers and water, pleasant and fresh, but product is missing and efficacy trust is weak for a skincare launch or consultation campaign.

candidates.title: Macro cream texture only
candidates.description: Beautiful cream texture macro with clean light and premium feel, but no package, no brand cue, and limited room for a complete cardnews message.

candidates.title: Overpromised medical before-after
candidates.description: Dramatic before-after skin claim with fake labels, medical device mood, unrealistic flawless skin, high legal and trust risk for cosmetics advertising.

candidates.title: Cheap splash discount banner
candidates.description: Crowded neon discount banner with many product boxes, water splash, unreadable sale typography, low premium signal, no calm skincare credibility.

candidates.title: Diamond ring controlled shadow hero
candidates.description: Diamond ring on a restrained charcoal surface, precise highlight, controlled shadow, elegant negative space for headline, product scale and material quality are clear.

candidates.title: Gold necklace editorial crop
candidates.description: Luxury necklace photographed with warm directional light, restrained background, enough side space for campaign copy, premium material reads clearly without excessive sparkle.

candidates.title: Sparkle detail macro
candidates.description: Beautiful gemstone sparkle macro with high material detail, but the crop is too tight and does not leave room for headline or campaign structure.

candidates.title: Elegant model hand pose
candidates.description: Elegant hand pose with a ring and soft skin tone, but product identity is slightly secondary and the layout would need stronger product focus for a collection hero.

candidates.title: Fantasy plastic gem render
candidates.description: Overly shiny fantasy render with plastic-like diamonds, rainbow glow, decorative stars, cheap gift-box mood, not credible as luxury jewelry.

candidates.title: Crowded sale poster jewelry
candidates.description: Crowded red sale poster with many jewelry items, fake discount text, loud badge graphics, no premium whitespace, product value feels cheap.
